subject: Offer & start-date for Senior Research Engineer — scheduling + redline routing
thread_summary: Offer call scheduling, internal routing of redlines to People Ops & Legal, candidate requests later start date and a relocation stipend; final DocuSign envelope sent with updated start window.
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Offer call & next steps for Senior Research Engineer (SRE)

Hi Sarah —

Really excited to follow up — the team would love to make you an offer for the Senior Research Engineer role. I know Greenline looped us in, so copying them. Can we schedule a 20–25 minute call today or tomorrow to walk through the package and pin down a starter window? Proposed times (PST): 4:00pm today, 10:00am or 2:00pm tomorrow.

Following the call, People Ops will email a PDF of the offer and a DocuSign link. If you have any immediate constraints on the start date (e.g., notice period, relocation), let us know so we can factor that into the offer.

Thanks, and congrats again.

— Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference

Nikhil — thank you so much! I'm honored and excited. I can do 2:00pm tomorrow PST. One note: I need to give 3 weeks' notice at my current employer and have a small relocation to the Bay Area. Would it be possible to propose a start in mid-Jan (week of Jan 11) rather than early Jan? Also curious whether Redwood offers any relocation or lump-sum support.

Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Sarah

Laura/Marissa/Tessa —

Looping you in from the candidate: Sarah needs a 3-week notice and asked about relocation. We have a call scheduled tomorrow at 2pm PST to present the package. Can we prepare: (1) an offer PDF with two start windows (early Jan / week of Jan 11) and (2) an explicit field for 'relocation stipend (if any)' so we can confirm on the call?

Marissa: can you draft the offer PDF and provision a DocuSign envelope after the call? If Legal needs to review anything for the relocation clause, please advise.

Tessa: please join the call and help with any candidate questions.

Thanks —
Nikhil

Attaching draft offer packet for SRE: Redwood_SRE_Offer_v1.pdf (attachment) — includes base, equity grant schedule, sign-on, and two proposed start windows: Jan 4 or week of Jan 11.

Also attaching a Word doc for any candidate redlines: SRE_offer_redlines_sarah.docx (attachment).

Quick notes from today's call (2:00pm PST):

- Attendees: Nikhil, Laura, Tessa, Sarah, Greenline (recruiter).
- Sarah confirmed interest; reiterated 3-week notice and preference for Jan 11 start window.
- We walked through total comp, equity vesting schedule, and sign-on of $25k (pro-rated). Sarah requested clarity on relocation support.
- Action items:
  * Marissa to update offer PDF to show preferred start = Jan 11 and alternative Jan 4 (if candidate pushes notice earlier).
  * Marissa to include relocation lump-sum line item and indicate approval threshold.
  * Nikhil/Laura to approve any relocation exception > $7,500.
  * If candidate returns redlines, route to legal-review@redwood.com and copy Laura + Marissa.

Sarah — thanks again for joining on short notice. We'll send the updated PDF today and a DocuSign link for your signature.

Best,
Tessa

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/EXAMPLE-12345
Envelope includes the offer and the Schedule A. Please review and sign at your convenience. Attachments: Redwood_SRE_Offer_v1.pdf (pdf), SRE_offer_redlines_sarah.docx (docx)
